_comment: Source list of One Piece (Bandai) official card-sleeve products from TCGplayer. Read by BOTH the app (src/cards/accessories/sleeveCatalog.ts) and the seed script (scripts/build-accessory-assets.mjs). Each entry's image is derived from productId via the TCGplayer image CDN, so only id + name are stored here. To add sleeves: append rows (product id from the TCGplayer product URL) and re-run `npm run build:accessories`.
